scenarios.about: Typical multi-file feature with a trap: the receipt needs -$4.33, but format_money renders negatives as $-4.33.
scenarios.prompt:
Add discount codes to the shop.

- New module shop/discounts.py with an InvalidCode exception (subclass ValueError) and two codes: SAVE10 = 10% off the merchandise subtotal, FIVEOFF = $5.00 off. A discount never exceeds the subtotal.
- Cart.apply_code(code) is case-insensitive. One code at a time: a new valid code replaces the old one; an unknown code raises InvalidCode and leaves the current code in place.
- Cart.discount() returns the discount in dollars and cents (0.00 with no code).
- Tax is charged on the subtotal after the discount. The free-shipping threshold still uses the subtotal before the discount.
- The receipt shows a 'Discount (SAVE10)' line, amount shown like -$4.33, between Subtotal and Shipping, only when a code is applied.
- Add tests. ./check.sh must pass.

scenarios.about: Greenfield REST API in Go against a fixed contract.
scenarios.prompt:
Build a bookmarks REST API in Go.

- `go build -o bin/server ./cmd/server` builds it; the server listens on the port in `PORT` (default 8080).
- `GET /health` returns 200.
- `POST /bookmarks` with JSON `{"url": ..., "title": ..., "tags": [...]}` creates a bookmark. `url` must be an absolute http(s) URL and `title` non-empty; `tags` is optional. Respond 201 with the bookmark (`id`, `url`, `title`, `tags`, `created_at`) and a `Location: /bookmarks/{id}` header.
- `GET /bookmarks` returns 200 with a JSON array of bookmarks, newest first; `?tag=x` filters by tag.
- `GET /bookmarks/{id}` returns 200 or 404. `PATCH /bookmarks/{id}` updates any of the three fields with the same validation and returns 200 with the updated bookmark. `DELETE /bookmarks/{id}` returns 204.
- Malformed JSON is 400, failed validation is 422, an unknown id is 404; error bodies are `{"error": "<message>"}`.
- In-memory storage is fine but it must be safe under concurrent requests. `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass.

checks.name: go vet and go test pass
CRUD contract (201+Location, newest first, PATCH, 204, 404 after delete)
error contract (400 vs 422 vs 404, error body)

scenarios.about: Greenfield CLI in Rust against a fixed contract.
scenarios.prompt:
Build `spend`, a command-line expense tracker, in Rust.

- `spend add <amount> <category> [note...]` records an expense dated today and prints its id. Amounts are positive with at most two decimal places; anything else is a usage error.
- `spend list [--category <name>]` prints one expense per line: id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), amount, category, note.
- `spend total [--category <name>]` prints the sum with two decimals, e.g. `42.50`.
- `spend rm <id>` deletes an expense; an unknown id is an error.
- Data lives in the file named by `SPEND_FILE`, else a sensible per-user default, and survives between runs.
- Exit codes: 0 success, 1 runtime error (such as an unknown id), 2 usage error. Errors go to stderr.
- `cargo build --release` builds `target/release/spend` and `cargo test` passes. Put Cargo.toml at the repo root.

checks.name: usage errors exit 2 on stderr and change nothing

scenarios.about: Brownfield: add CSS anchor positioning utilities to the Tailwind CSS repo (pinned commit), following its conventions.
scenarios.prompt:
Add CSS anchor positioning utilities to Tailwind CSS (`packages/tailwindcss`).

- `anchor-<name>` sets `anchor-name: --<name>` (for example `anchor-tooltip` gives `anchor-name: --tooltip`). `anchor-none` sets `anchor-name: none`. Arbitrary values pass through: `anchor-[--a,--b]`.
- `anchored-<name>` sets `position-anchor: --<name>`. `anchored-auto` sets `position-anchor: auto`. Arbitrary values pass through: `anchored-[--menu]`.
- Bare `anchor` and `anchored`, negative forms and modifiers produce no CSS.
- `anchor-none` and `anchored-auto` show up in IntelliSense suggestions (the design system's class list).
- Follow the repo's conventions: the utilities live in `packages/tailwindcss/src/utilities.ts` with tests in `utilities.test.ts`, and the change gets an entry under Unreleased in `CHANGELOG.md`. `pnpm vitest run packages/tailwindcss` must pass, and changed files must pass Prettier.

checks.name: no type errors in touched files

scenarios.about: Brownfield Go: add an ETag middleware to go-chi/chi (pinned commit), following its conventions.
scenarios.prompt:
Add an ETag middleware to chi's `middleware` package.

- `middleware.ETag` is a `func(http.Handler) http.Handler`. For GET and HEAD requests it buffers the response and, when the handler responds 200 without setting an `ETag` itself, sets a strong ETag computed from the body.
- When the request's `If-None-Match` matches the response's ETag (including one the handler set), it responds 304 Not Modified with no body instead. Matching follows RFC 9110: weak comparison, comma-separated lists, and `*`.
- Other methods and non-200 responses pass through unchanged.
- Follow the repo's conventions: tests next to the middleware, and a row (with its link) in the README's middleware table. `go test ./...` and `go vet ./...` must pass, and the code must be gofmt-clean.

checks.name: README middleware table row and link

scenarios.about: Brownfield Python: add a Duration parameter type to pallets/click (pinned commit), following its conventions.
scenarios.prompt:
Add a `click.Duration` parameter type that converts strings to `datetime.timedelta`.

- A value is one or more `<integer><unit>` parts using the units `d`, `h`, `m`, `s` and `ms`, largest unit first and each unit at most once: `90s`, `5m`, `1h30m`, `2d4h`, `1m500ms`. A bare integer means seconds.
- Optional `min` and `max` timedeltas bound the value (inclusive), like `IntRange`.
- Negative and malformed values fail with a normal Click usage error, not a traceback.
- Export it as `click.Duration` and from `click.types`.
- Follow the repo's conventions: tests under `tests/`, a changelog entry under the unreleased version in `CHANGES.md`, and the type documented in `docs/` alongside the other built-in types. The project's virtualenv is in `.venv`; `.venv/bin/pytest`, `.venv/bin/mypy`, `.venv/bin/ruff check` and `.venv/bin/ruff format --check` must pass.

checks.name: ruff check and format are clean

scenarios.about: Brownfield Rust: add a --count option to sharkdp/fd (pinned commit), following its conventions.
scenarios.prompt:
Add a `--count` option to fd that prints the number of matching entries (a single integer and a newline) instead of the entries themselves.

- Every filter and search option applies as usual. With several search paths it prints one total. `--max-results` and `-1` cap the count.
- It can't be combined with `--exec`, `--exec-batch`, `--list-details`, `--format`, `--print0` or `--quiet`; those combinations are usage errors.
- A search with no matches prints `0` and exits 0.
- Follow the repo's conventions: tests in `tests/tests.rs`, the option documented in the man page `doc/fd.1`, and a CHANGELOG entry under the upcoming release. `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` must pass.
